g.text: realm-agent: Local Capture, Existing SPIFFE Egress

text.tspan: lo + realm0 dummy / No external link or default route
Automatic: enabled isolated native services and supported rootless containers. Host-network / external workloads are excluded.
No Internet egress -> external DNS REFUSED and public TCP denied. Other external UDP is denied, including QUIC.
Worker listener failure or OOM stays within that workload; recovery is retried independently.
Controller failure leaves the namespace without a direct external route; existing proxied connections may break during recovery.
Application DoH / DoT remains encrypted application traffic; ordinary DNS capture cannot override it.
Solid links: requests. Dashed links: startup, local control and certificate access. Responses follow the reverse path.
Own resource cgroup + read-only mount namespace
128 MiB / 64 tasks / 1 CPU; no SPIRE API
DNS: local aliases, otherwise DoH via Internet egress
Native system unit binding; exclusive rootless container UID
Explicit internal prefix/port route or Internet route
Caller SPIFFE ID + expected receiver ID
Validate caller SPIFFE ID + receiver policy
Unix backend or private loopback adapter
Gateway and TUN stay outside app BPF capture
HTTPS payload TLS stays end to end
Real answers, not host fake-IP mappings
TCP connect, DNS send/recv, peer restoration
Original destination in bounded BPF map
